concept_attempts.feedback: Selected. Preserves broad joined upper lobes, opaque metallic green-grey mass, blue central emitter, two brass neck bands and lower luminous nodes; avoids the old sharp-shard approximation.

issues: Crown and flanks too spherical; visible shoulder gap around neck unlike continuous ore-like sides.
Emitter seating protrudes too much, producing tube-like profile.
Alloy too glossy, emission too flat/white; strengthen restrained mineral relief and roughness.
Continuous sidewalls corrected, but displacement is too coarse and produces visibly harsh surface patches.
Primary optic must be inset into an actual boolean recess rather than depend only on a backing cylinder.
Broad shell shows discontinuous dark angular patches at smart-projected UV islands; use continuous cylindrical coordinates with seam on rear and restrained mineral patina.

final_review: Final imported GLB retains the broad joined upper mass, continuous mineral-metal flanks, blue inset optic, two separated brass collars and smaller lower nodes. Continuous rear-seamed UVs and restrained patina replace the rejected dark atlas-island patches. Broad shapes are intentionally quiet rather than densely panelled.
limitations: Precise lobes, rear service closure and stress relief are authored from limited legacy evidence.
At close-up the sculpt is simplified relative to ImageGen; shape/colour identity and gameplay-scale readability take priority over copying every generated crevice.
No recovered metric height, calibrated game state, construction implementation, Android timing or final user approval is claimed.
